# Amos Chapter 7 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 336r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/AMO_007_page_001.jpg

---

**7:1** Thus the-Lord [Adonai] YHWH showed-me [hir'ani]: and-behold, he-was-forming [yotser] locusts [govai] at-the-beginning [bi-techillat] of-the-rising of-the-late-crop [leqesh]; and-behold, the-late-crop [leqesh] after the-king's [ha-melekh] mowings [gizzei].

**7:2** And-it-was, when they-finished [killah] devouring [le-ekhol] the-vegetation [esev] of-the-land, and-I-said, "Lord [Adonai] YHWH, forgive [selach], please [na]! How can-Yaakov [Jacob] stand [yaqum]? For he [is] small [qaton]."

**7:3** YHWH relented [nicham] concerning this: "It-will-not be [lo tihyeh]," said YHWH.

**7:7** Thus he-showed-me: and-behold, the-Lord standing [nitsav] upon a-wall [chomat] [made by] a-plumb-line [anakh], and-in-his-hand [u-veyado] a-plumb-line.

**7:8** And-said YHWH to-me, "What [are] you seeing [ro'eh], Amos?" And-I-said, "A-plumb-line [anakh]." And-said the-Lord, "Behold, I [am] setting [sam] a-plumb-line in-the-midst [be-qerev] of-my-people Yisra'el; I-will-not again [lo osif od] pass-over [avor] for-him."

**7:10** Then-sent [vayyishlach] Amatsyah [Amaziah] the-priest [kohen] of-Beit-El to-Yarov'am [Jeroboam] king of-Yisra'el, saying, "Amos has-conspired [qashar] against-you in-the-midst of-the-house of-Yisra'el; the-land [ha-arets] is-not able [lo tukhal] to-bear [lehakhil] all his-words [devarav]."

**7:14** And-answered [vayyaan] Amos and-said to Amatsyah, "Not [lo] a-prophet [navi] I [am], and-not a-son [ben] of-a-prophet [navi] I [am]; but [ki] a-herdsman [voqer] I [am] and-a-dresser [voles] of-sycamore-figs [shiqmim]."

**7:15** "And-took-me [vayyiqqacheni] YHWH from-behind [me-acharei] the-flock [ha-tson] and-said YHWH to-me, 'Go [lekh], prophesy [hinnave] to my-people [ammi] Yisra'el.'"

**7:17** "Therefore, thus says YHWH: 'Your-wife [ishtekha] in-the-city will-be-a-prostitute [tizneh], and-your-sons [banekha] and-your-daughters [u-benotekha] by-the-sword [ba-cherev] will-fall [yipolu], and-your-land [ve-admatekha] by-a-line [ba-chevel] will-be-divided [techalleq], and-you upon unclean [teme'ah] land [adamah] will-die [tamut], and-Yisra'el will-surely-go-into-exile [galoh yigleh] from upon his-land [admato].'"


---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.7-8 — The plumb line:** *Anakh* is often translated "plumb line" but the word is rare and its meaning uncertain. Some scholars suggest "tin" (the metal) — God holds up a standard against which Israel is measured and found wanting.

**v.14 — "not a prophet":** Amos's famous self-identification — he is not a professional prophet or a member of a prophetic guild ("son of a prophet"). He is a livestock-breeder and farmer, called directly by YHWH. This claim undermines Amaziah's attempt to dismiss him as a paid prophet.

*— EMET*
